  CONSTRAINT `production_membership_billing_subscriptions_bounds` CHECK (((length(`id`) = 36) and (length(`seal`) = 64) and (`account_id` > 0) and (`user_id` > 0) and (`identity_origin_id` > 0) and (length(`provider_account_hash`) = 64) and (length(`customer_ref_hash`) = 64) and (length(`subscription_ref_hash`) = 64) and (length(`price_ref_hash`) = 64) and (length(`approval_binding_hash`) = 64) and (((`mode` = _utf8mb4'test') and (`provenance` = _utf8mb4'synthetic_rehearsal')) or ((`mode` = _utf8mb4'live') and (`provenance` = _utf8mb4'verified_production')))))

  `retrieval_end_position` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `freshness_deadline` varchar(19) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,

  `sdk_reference` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,

  `seal` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` varchar(19) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `retrieval_token` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_allocation_token` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_allocation_token` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,

  UNIQUE KEY `production_membership_billing_observations_u1` (`retrieval_position`),
  UNIQUE KEY `production_membership_billing_observations_u2` (`retrieval_end_position`),
  CONSTRAINT `production_membership_billing_observations_f0` FOREIGN KEY (`invoice_id`) REFERENCES `production_membership_billing_invoices` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `production_membership_billing_observations_bounds` CHECK (((length(`id`) = 36) and (length(`seal`) = 64) and (`sequence` between 1 and 10000) and (`outcome` in (_ascii'settled',_ascii'not_settled',_ascii'unknown',_ascii'refused',_ascii'reversed')) and (length(`facts_hash`) = 64) and (length(`prior_seal`) = 64) and (`retrieved_at` < `freshness_deadline`) and (length(`retrieval_started_at`) = 26) and (`retrieval_position` > 0) and (`retrieval_end_position` > 0) and (`retrieval_end_position` > `retrieval_position`) and (length(`api_version`) between 1 and 32) and (length(`sdk_reference`) = 40) and ((`outcome` <> _ascii'settled') or ((`line_period_start` is not null) and (`line_period_end` is not null) and (`line_period_start` < `line_period_end`) and (`amount_minor` is not null) and (`amount_minor` > 0) and (`currency` is not null) and (length(`currency`) = 3)))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
